sermon.title: There is Nothing New Under the Sun— November 15, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer tests Ecclesiastes 1:9 against Scripture: what God did in Genesis 1 He did again after the flood, and He will make a new heaven and earth. Jesus will not return until the restoration of all things the prophets foretold. Believers prepare His way, are changed from glory to glory, and share truth that prevents needless harm.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What were the works Paul spoke of?
faqs.answer: The shadow laws that pointed to the real truth; you need the real thing.

faqs.question: What earth will the meek inherit?
faqs.answer: He wants the new earth where righteousness dwells.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.
But you be watchful in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
